'''Andrew Espinola''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 17th, 4 (−46) at [[August 2000 Austin tournament]] on 19 August 2000, according to Brian Guthrie's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1157">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-23-austin-tx-8-19-sm-report-dsii-discussiond1157/ austin-tx-8-19-sm-report-dsii-discussion], DeckTech (Brian "Red 81" Guthrie, 23 August 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-23-austin-tx-8-19-sm-report-dsii-discussiond1157/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
